tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Search the Trusgent Trust Layer directory for people and businesses with public Agent Cards. Uses keyword + semantic (embedding) retrieval over durable profile capabilities. Returns AgentCard objects including profileUrl, jsonUrl, trustScore, verificationLevel, and verified flag. Prefer verified age

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Fetch one full Agent Card by public agentId (same ID used in /t/{id}). Returns structured profile fields, trustScore, verification, and canonical URLs for humans and machines.

tools.name: verify_agent
tools.description: Lightweight verification lookup: whether an AgentID exists, is public, and its verification level / trustScore. Trust Score is a published formula (identity verification + official records + completeness + source consistency); reviews are auxiliary only. Prefer this before citing or recommending an

tools.name: get_reviews
tools.description: List approved public reviews for an Agent Card (same id as /t/{id}). Includes mutual-review perspective (BUYER|SELLER|PEER), anchorKind (NONE|LEDGER|EXTERNAL|ORDER), and whether the review is interaction-anchored. Prefer anchored reviews when weighing reputation.

tools.name: get_registry
tools.description: Fetch one official Hong Kong registry record by registryId (e.g. fehd-3715038328). Returns official fields plus provenance and verify links. Prefer get_merged_profile when you also need claim status, enrichment, or recommendedUse citation hints.

tools.name: search_registry
tools.description: Search Hong Kong official Business Agents (~60k+ registry rows) by name, address, licence number, or registryId. Optional source filter (FEHD_RESTAURANT, CR_COMPANY, EHEALTH_HCP, etc.). Each hit includes a businessAgent facet (claimStatus, capabilities, inquiryUrl). Unclaimed rows are still callable

tools.name: get_merged_profile
tools.description: Preferred HK Business Agent read: official registry fields merged with claimed Agent Card data and cited third-party enrichment. Includes businessAgent (claimStatus + capabilities), dossierLayers, citationPolicy, trustBreakdown, and recommendedUse. Unclaimed official rows remain callable — use creat

tools.name: create_inquiry
tools.description: Send a contact/claim intent for an official registry row (identity provenance). Works for unclaimed rows. If already claimed, prefer get_agent / verify_agent / get_reviews. Shop booking lives on Bgent (www.bgent.io). Do not invent phone numbers for unclaimed businesses.

tools.name: list_rankings
tools.description: List Trusgent ranking boards. Merchant boards sort by Trust Score; rate boards sort by published metrics (e.g. HKD fixed-deposit rates). Returns catalog with htmlUrl + jsonUrl per board.

tools.name: get_ranking
tools.description: Fetch one ranking board as structured items for citation. Prefer this over scraping HTML. Includes methodology, asOf, paidPlacement=false, and recommendedUse. For market boards pass tenureMonths (1|3|6|12).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_agent, verify_agent, get_reviews, get_ranking · Private data: verify_agent, get_registry, create_inquiry · Public sink: create_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_agent, verify_agent, get_reviews, get_ranking · Private data: verify_agent, get_registry, create_inquiry · Public sink: create_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "get_agent" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Fetch one full Agent Card by public agentId (same ID used in /t/{id} and /b/{id}). Returns structured profile fields, trustScore, verification, and canonical URLs for humans and machines." → after: "Fetch one full Agent Card by public agentId (same ID used in /t/{id}). Returns structured profile fields, trustScore, verification, and canonical URLs for humans and machines."

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
